extracted_information: The web content provides C# code examples for controlling the Windows Firewall using the 'WindowsFirewallHelper' library. The examples demonstrate how to create and manage application and port rules, retrieve existing rules, remove rules, and configure firewall profiles. It also shows advanced usage applicable to Windows Vista, Windows 7, and Windows 8 and above.
features: Manage Windows Firewall rules (add, remove, list)
Add program to Windows Firewall exception list
Support for different firewall rule types (application, port)
Support for advanced security features (Windows Vista+)
Support for specific Windows versions (Win7+, Win8+ for advanced rules)

temporal_info.library_version_2_release_date_note: Readme file is for version 2, check V1 branch for older readme.

basic_examples.description: Creating and registering a new application exception rule for outbound traffic on the currently active profile.
Creating and registering a new port rule for inbound traffic on the currently active profile.
Getting the list of all registered rules.
Disabling notifications for all firewall profiles.

advanced_examples.description: Creating a heavily customized application rule (some parts applicable to Windows Vista, Windows 7 and above).
Working directly with the desired firewall management class without using the FirewallManager to add a new port rule (limited to Windows 8 and above).
advanced_examples.code: if(FirewallWAS.IsSupported&&FirewallWASRuleWin8.IsSupported){varrule=newFirewallWASRuleWin8("My Port Rule",1080,FirewallAction.Allow,FirewallDirection.Inbound,FirewallProfiles.Domain|FirewallProfiles.Private|FirewallProfiles.Public){Description="'My Port Rule' Allows Inbound traffic to my local Proxy Server from Wireless Adapters",NetworkInterfaceTypes=NetworkInterfaceTypes.Wireless,Protocol=FirewallProtocol.TCP};FirewallWAS.Instance.Rules.Add(rule);}
